description: Finds and verifies a company's social media profiles from its website URL. This SpaceFast preview exposes the lookup engine as plain HTTP endpoints in addition to the web UI; the production build is UI-only.
name: Brand Connector Pro

skills.description: POST /api/lookup with JSON body {"url": "example.com"}. Returns a BrandLookupResult: brandName, platforms[] (each with platformId, status, and entries[] carrying handle, url, rating, and evidence strings), notFound[] platform names, and blocked:true when the target site refuses automated access. Rate limit: 20 requests/minute per caller. Evidence strength is a label (strong/moderate/weak), never a percentage. Private/internal/loopback targets are refused.
skills.name: lookup

skills.description: POST /api/search with JSON body {"query": "brand name"}. Returns an array of SearchHit objects (title, url, snippet). Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per caller. Best-effort DuckDuckGo HTML fallback; may return [] when the search provider blocks automated requests.
skills.name: search
